label: Embed
description: Turn texts into embedding vectors through a wired OpenRouter provider, whose model names the embedding model (voyageai/voyage-4, openai/text-embedding-3-small, ...).

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Wire an OpenRouterProvider whose model names the model to use.

inputs.name: texts
inputs.description: One text or a list; one vector comes back per text.

inputs.name: dimensions
inputs.description: Shrink vectors to this many dimensions (models supporting matryoshka sizing only).
